declared_unchecked_patterns.*::protocol_id: checked as a constant by check_constants, not per report
declared_unchecked_patterns.CONFIRMATION_COHORT.json::*: cohort legality metadata; the program digests are recomputed from the pinned inputs by programs()
declared_unchecked_patterns.ENGINEERING_DECISION.json::parity_eviden: free text naming a test file
declared_unchecked_patterns.ENGINEERING_DECISION.json::reason: free text restating the recomputed decision
declared_unchecked_patterns.FROZEN_SELECTION.json::inference.*: free text and the route constants (compared with ROUTES by check_constants)
declared_unchecked_patterns.FROZEN_SELECTION.json::learning_track.*: source hashes of the learning track; the successor checker owns source identity
declared_unchecked_patterns.FROZEN_SELECTION.json::reporting.*: source hash; the successor checker owns it
declared_unchecked_patterns.FROZEN_SELECTION.json::sources.*: source hashes at the freeze; the successor checker owns source identity
declared_unchecked_patterns.LEARNING_FEASIBILITY.json::evaluation_se: needs the codec (structural_encoding.decode); the auditor imports no codec
declared_unchecked_patterns.SELECTION.json::selection.rule: free text restating the rule that is recomputed
declared_unchecked_patterns.export/candidate/EXPORT_VALIDATION.json:: pinned-workspace evidence; exit codes are compared, identity strings are labels
declared_unchecked_patterns.export/candidate/compiler_MANIFEST.json:: hash of the frozen owner generator; checker
declared_unchecked_patterns.learning/DESIGN_*.json::designs.*.ranker: absolute path; its hash is checked
declared_unchecked_patterns.learning/DESIGN_*.json::designs.*.sensit: needs the codec (structural_encoding.decode); the auditor imports no codec
declared_unchecked_patterns.learning/DESIGN_*.json::manifest: path; the manifest it names is read and checked
